playAbility: Your current Hero gets -50, but your next 2 Heroes get +15 each.

name: Sandstorm
playAbility: Shuffle all your Plays in your hand back into your Playbook and draw 4 new Plays.

name: Crystal Ball
playAbility: Pick a number 1-6, then your opponent picks a different number 1-6; roll a die; if it lands on either player's number their Hero gets +30.

name: Double or Nothin
playAbility: Flip a coin twice; if both land on heads, play the top card from your Hero Deck and add its power to the active Hero in this Battle.

name: Gavel of Justice
playAbility: Lower the opponent's Hero by -30.

name: Heads-Up!
playAbility: Flip a coin 4 times; your Hero gets +5 each time the coin lands on heads.

name: Jump Ball
playAbility: Flip a coin; if heads, your Hero gets +10, if tails, your Hero gets -10.

name: Lucky Seven
playAbility: Roll a die two times; if the numbers add up to 7 your Hero gets +100; if any other number you must discard a random Hero from your hand.

name: Lucky Bounce
playAbility: Roll a die; your Hero gets +5x the number; (ex. If you roll a 3 your Hero gets +15).

name: No Huddle
playAbility: If you activated a Play in the previous Battle, this Hero gets +15.

name: Robin Who
playAbility: Steal -5 from your opponent's Hero and give +5 to your own Hero.

name: Pinch HItter
playAbility: Next Battle you can Substitute for free (0 Hot Dog cost).
